battle.name: 第一次阿散蒂戰爭
battle.theater: 黃金海岸南岸開普海岸一線
battle.brief: 一八二三年阿散蒂與沿海芬特諸邦的衝突全面爆發：阿散蒂大軍攻入黃金海岸南部，圍攻英軍據守的開普海岸堡壘，英芬聯軍在費亞塞一役以制式燧發槍的線列齊射與刺刀近戰解圍。線性列陣的射速與精度，就係英方以數百人抵住數萬大軍的本錢。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是大不列顛王室的黃金海岸殖民體系，與以庫馬西為都的阿散蒂帝國。英方由三層組成：最上是殖民地部與陸軍部在倫敦的決策，落到殖民地就是駐節於開普海岸的總督府，查爾斯·麥卡錫在一八二三年至一八二四年任總督，掌管沿海城堡、軍械庫、商務法庭與盟邦之間的裁決；中層是英國陸軍與皇家海軍的西非分遣隊，步兵多自西印度軍團與民兵抽調，海軍在西非的分遣艦隊負責封鎖海岸、護航商船與支援登陸；最下是沿海諸邦的聯盟，芬特聯邦由阿諾馬布、開普海岸、溫尼巴等邦組成，設有由女主與各邦首長組成的議會，戰時出民兵、嚮導與糧食。英方實力單薄，必須靠城堡的城牆、海軍的船和聯盟對地形的熟悉，來補人數的不足。阿散蒂一方則是純粹的王室國家：阿散蒂王居庫馬西王宮，十餘個師團式的部隊由王廷元帥統率，每師以千計，配屬火槍手、刀矛手與挑夫；王宮另設近衛與火槍隊，受阿散蒂節制的沿海附庸邦則供應糧食、象牙、奴隸與役夫。海陸之間的商路是這場戰爭的勝負手：英軍的彈藥要靠商船靠岸，阿散蒂的洋槍與銅砲也靠同一條海岸貿易線，從丹麥、荷蘭與英國商人手上換來。
countriesEn: The two sides were the British Crown's Gold Coast colonial establishment and the Asante Empire, whose capital was Kumasi. The British side was built in three layers. At the top sat London, where the Colonial Office and the War Office took the decisions; in the colony itself stood the governorship at Cape Coast, where Charles MacCarthy, governor from 1823 to 1824, controlled the coastal forts, the ordnance depots, the commercial courts and the arbitration between the allied states. In the middle came the West African detachments of the British army and the Royal Navy: infantry drawn mainly from the West India regiments and the militia, and a naval squadron off West Africa whose duty was to blockade the coast, escort the merchant shipping and support the landing of stores. At the bottom lay the alliance of the coastal states. The Fante Confederacy, made up of Anomabu, Cape Coast, Winneba and other polities, had its own council of chiefs and a queen mother, and in wartime furnished militia, guides and food. British numbers were thin, so the walls of the forts, the Navy's ships and the alliance's knowledge of the ground had to make up for the shortage of men. The Asante side was a purely royal state: the Asantehene held court at Kumasi, and more than ten division-sized bodies were commanded by the court's generals, each numbering in the thousands and carrying musketeers, men with knives and spears, and porters; the palace had its own guard and firing squad, while the coastal states subject to Kumasi supplied grain, ivory, captives and labour. The sea lane was the hinge of the whole war. British ammunition had to come ashore in merchant ships, and the Asante muskets and bronze guns were bought over the same coastal trade from Danish, Dutch and British merchants.
people: 英方最關鍵的兩個人都死在一八二三年至一八二四年。駐節官威廉·比塞特一八二三年自庫馬西返回開普海岸途中遭埋伏遇害，頭顱與隨身財物被帶回庫馬西，此事把沿海諸邦對阿散蒂的怨恨推到臨界點；殖民地總督查爾斯·麥卡錫則在費亞塞一役的停戰議和場合，與同行的英軍官員被阿散蒂部隊殺害，頭顱送回庫馬西，史稱麥卡錫慘案，倫敦為此輿論大譁，議會要求殖民當局必須反擊。麥卡錫原本想以外交解決爭端：他曾提出由英方出錢回贖金凳歸還芬特諸邦，又試圖以英方代付沿海邦的戰俘賠償，換取阿散蒂放棄宗主權，這些方案都未被接受，談判在一八二三年底破裂。戰後接手交涉的是駐節官喬治·麥克萊恩，由他代表英方與王廷討論賠款分期與金凳的處置，把雙方拉回條約而不是戰場。阿散蒂一方，奠定帝國的奧塞·圖圖一世在戰爭爆發時已病重，一八二四年由其子奧塞·夸梅·潘因接位，這位新王把收回金凳列為首要目標，並把沿海諸邦的進貢提到不容商議的地步。統兵的大將阿曼夸在費亞塞失利後被召回，據說隨即被處死，各書說法不一。真正決定沿海戰線的，還有芬特諸邦的首長與阿諾馬布、開普海岸一線的民兵首領；英方史料記載，戰事進行中確有沿海邦的戰士脫離阿散蒂行列投向聯軍。
peopleEn: The two most important British men of this war were both dead by 1824. William Bisset, the British resident, was ambushed and killed on the road from Kumasi to Cape Coast in 1823, and his head and belongings were carried back to Kumasi, which drove the coastal states' anger to the breaking point. Charles MacCarthy, the colonial governor, was killed together with the British officers who went with him at the parley that followed the battle of Feyiase, their heads being sent back to Kumasi in what came to be called the MacCarthy massacre; the affair caused an uproar in London, where parliament demanded that the colonial authorities strike back. MacCarthy had wanted to settle the quarrel by diplomacy: he proposed buying the Golden Stool back from the Asante to hand it to the Fante, and tried to have Britain pay the Asante's claims for captives in exchange for a renunciation of the suzerainty over the coastal states. None of it was accepted, and the talks broke down at the end of 1823. George Maclean took over the negotiations afterwards, representing Britain in discussions of the indemnity instalments and of the fate of the stool, and brought both sides back to a treaty rather than a battlefield. On the Asante side, Osei Tutu I, who had founded the empire, was gravely ill when the war began and died in 1824; his son Osei Kwame Panyin succeeded him, made the recovery of the Golden Stool his first priority, and raised the tribute of the coastal states to a level that admitted no negotiation. Amankwah, the general who commanded the army, was recalled after the defeat at Feyiase and is said to have been executed at once, though the accounts differ. What really decided the coastal line were the chiefs of the Fante states and the militia leaders along Anomabu and Cape Coast; the British record notes that warriors from the coastal states did desert the Asante ranks and go over to the allies during the fighting.
kits: 本卡的燧發槍，是英國在一七一〇年前後定為步兵制式的一型定裝火藥槍，胡桃木槍身，口徑約五點四英分，約一點三七公分，連刺刀全槍重約四公斤半，槍管長約一公尺六七，槍口初速約每秒三百二十米，是當時歐洲最精良的步兵火器。它靠擊錘敲擊燧石迸出火星點燃藥盤，風雨之中不需像火繩槍那樣提防火繩熄滅，射速因此可以維持在一分鐘三至四發；同一型槍自一七一〇年代用到一八三〇年代。與之配套的是插銷式刺刀，槍管下的插座在一八二四年被英軍取消，刺刀改以插銷直接插入槍口。戰場上的英軍兵力雖少，每一排卻全靠這型槍維持線性齊射：前排跪、後排立，號令一落，數百支槍同時噴出火藥煙與鐵砂。另一邊，阿散蒂的火力同樣來自燧發槍，卻是零星購置的歐製獵槍與軍槍，經海岸商人售入，數量遠多於英軍，卻全無制式補給；其銅製野砲多為十六、十七世紀的歐洲舊式，用來守村寨與木柵。英軍隨軍另有數門三磅與六磅輕野砲、康格里夫火箭，並有海軍舷砲在近岸支援；阿散蒂側則是長矛、砍刀、藤盾與火把，加上象、轎、擔夫組成的運輸隊，糧食為玉米、薯類與蕉類，彈藥仰賴海岸輸入的黑色火藥。
kitsEn: The flintlock musket on this card is the standard British infantry arm settled in around 1710: a muzzle-loading musket with a walnut stock, of about .54 calibre, roughly 1.37 cm, weighing about four and a half kilogrammes with its bayonet, its barrel about 1.67 metres long and its muzzle velocity around 320 metres per second, one of the finest infantry weapons in Europe. It fired by striking a frizzen with the cock so that sparks lit the priming pan, and unlike the matchlock it did not have to be kept alight in wind and rain, which allowed a rate of fire of three or four rounds a minute; the same pattern was used from the 1710s right through to the 1830s. It went with the plug bayonet, the socket under the barrel being abolished in the British army in 1824, after which the bayonet was plugged straight into the muzzle. British numbers on the ground were small, but every platoon rested on this musket for its linear volleys: the front rank kneeling, the second standing, and on the signal several hundred muskets going off together in one cloud of powder smoke and shot. On the other side the Asante fired flintlocks too, but they were European hunting and military guns bought in singly from coastal traders, far more numerous than the British weapons yet wholly dependent on private purchase; their bronze field guns were old European pieces of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, used to defend villages and stockades. The British column also brought a few three- and six-pounder light field guns, Congreve rockets and naval broadside support from the ships offshore, while the Asante had spears, cutting swords, rattan shields and torches, with transport drawn by elephants, litters and porters, food of maize, tubers and plantains, and ammunition that depended on black powder imported over the coast.
tactics: 阿散蒂的戰術是典型的非洲王國大軍戰法：以密集縱隊作戰，人數本身就是火力，一次投入一師或數師，用前排的刀矛與火槍把敵陣湧滿，再用後排的投射兵器與火槍覆蓋上去；進攻時善用村寨、土壘與林地，逼近之後再以白刃衝撞英軍的方形陣。圍攻開普海岸時，阿散蒂大軍不硬攻城牆，而是沿城郊掘壕築土壘，逐步切斷堡壘與內陸、以及與海運之間的聯繫，並在夜裡多次襲擊守軍與村落，消耗守方的火藥與糧食，等對方先耗盡。英軍這邊人少，沒有餘力分頭守備，因此把重心放在堡壘與密集的射擊紀律上：步兵按排成列，前排跪射、後排立射，射速雖只有每分鐘三到四發，節奏卻由鼓點與號角統一控制，在三四百米內形成持續而單向的火力；等火槍與地形把敵人困住，近身戰才由刺刀衝鋒收尾。掩護方面，英軍依賴城堡的城牆、壕溝與柵牆，芬特民兵則熟悉村落、灌木叢與沼澤，常以側翼襲擊與游擊切斷阿散蒂的糧道與退路。補給線是英軍的弱點：彈藥、鹽、布匹與糧食全靠海船定期靠岸，一旦海岸被封鎖或商船延誤，前線的火力立刻下降；阿散蒂的糧道靠象與擔夫在內陸搬運，路線長而分散，一旦被切斷，遠征軍的推進就放慢。
tacticsEn: Asante tactics were the classic way an African kingdom fought with mass, and the numbers were themselves the firepower: dense columns, one division or several committed at once, the leading ranks of knives, spears and muskets swamping the enemy line while the rear ranks covered them with missiles and shot. The advance used villages, earthworks and woodland, coming up close and then smashing into the British squares with cold steel. In the siege of Cape Coast the Asante army chose not to assault the walls directly. It dug trenches and raised earthworks in the suburbs, cut the fort off step by step from the interior and from the sea, and made repeated night attacks on the garrison and on the villages, wearing down the defenders' powder and grain and waiting for the other side to exhaust itself first. The British had too few men to garrison everything, so their weight rested on the forts and on disciplined shooting: the infantry stood in platoons, the front rank kneeling and the second standing, the rate of fire only three or four rounds a minute, but the timing was given by the drums and the bugles so that within three or four hundred metres a steady one-way fire went down the lane, and when the musket and the ground had pinned the enemy, the bayonet charge finished it. For cover the British relied on the walls, ditches and palisades of the forts, while the Fante militia, who knew the villages, the bush and the marshes, worked on the flanks, cutting the Asante supply lines and retreat by raids and running attacks. Supply was the British weakness: ammunition, salt, cloth and grain all had to land from the sea, and the moment the coast was blockaded or the merchant ships delayed, the fire of the line fell away. The Asante supply line ran on elephants and porters along long inland tracks, and once that was cut, the advance of any expeditionary column had to slow to the pace of the road.
data: 留下數字的地方不多，而且各書互相矛盾，寧可存疑也不可亂填。兵力方面，阿散蒂一八二四年越境大軍通常記為一萬五千至二萬五千人，槍械比例低於英軍；英方聯軍總數各說不一，約在三千至五千之間，其中正規英軍與海軍陸戰隊往往只有數百人，其餘是芬特民兵與北方豪薩騎兵。日期方面，費亞塞一役記為一八二四年一月十八日，阿散蒂對開普海岸的圍攻自一八二四年一月起，約莫三個月後解圍。距離方面，開普海岸到庫馬西的道路約一百九十公里，英軍的實際推進遠沒有走完這條路。可以推算的是火力密度：英軍以數百支制式燧發槍的齊射，對上數萬人的密集縱隊，單次齊射的投射量約數百顆鐵砂；每兵隨身攜帶的紙包火藥通常只夠數十發，更多靠後方供應。一八二二年英國以約十二萬鎊的價款向丹麥購入艾爾米納等沿海商站，價數諸說略異，是本戰前沿岸最齊全的一次英方整備；戰後阿散蒂應付的賠款則各書記載不一，可確認的是分期支付，總額遠高於當地一年的歲收。至於費亞塞一役的年份，舊文獻中有寫成一八二二年的，與一八二四年的記載互相矛盾，以後者為準。
dataEn: Few figures survive, and the books contradict one another, so it is better to record the doubt than to invent a number. On strength: the Asante army that crossed the border in 1824 is usually put at between fifteen and twenty-five thousand men, with a lower proportion of firearms than the British; the size of the allied British force is given variously at something between three and five thousand, of whom the British regulars and Royal Marines were often only a few hundred, the rest being Fante militia and northern Hausa cavalry. On dates: the battle of Feyiase is given as 18 January 1824, and the siege of Cape Coast began in January 1824 and was relieved about three months later. On distance: the road from Cape Coast to Kumasi runs about one hundred and ninety kilometres, and the British never travelled any real part of it. What can be reasoned out is the density of fire: several hundred service muskets firing in volley put several hundred balls into a massed column at a time, and a soldier carried only a few dozen paper charges on his person, the rest coming up from the rear. In 1822 Britain had bought the Danish coastal stations, Elmina and the rest, for about one hundred and twenty thousand pounds, the price being given with slight variations, and this was the fullest single British preparation on the coast before the war; the indemnity the Asante afterwards agreed to pay is recorded inconsistently, the one thing clear being that it was paid in instalments and amounted to far more than the local revenue of a single year. As for the year of the battle of Feyiase, some older accounts give 1822, which contradicts the record of 1824; the later date is the one to keep.
cause: 起因是一連串壓在一起的麻煩，最表面的是那把金凳。一八二〇年，阿散蒂王廷把象徵王權與國運的金凳從海岸帶到庫馬西，沿海芬特諸邦一向自認是金凳的守護者，這次搬遷等於撕毀舊有的默契；此後阿散蒂要求把金凳送回海岸，沿海邦要求王廷歸還，兩邊的疙瘩越結越深。第二層是進貢：阿散蒂帝國在內陸推行對沿海諸邦的宗主權，每年要黃金、象牙、奴隸與貨物的進貢，這筆收入正是王宮常備軍與火槍的來源；沿海邦在英國保護下逐步脫離這套關係，雙方都以為對方會先讓步。第三層是英方的外交失敗。一八二三年，駐節官威廉·比塞特在往庫馬西的路上被殺，沿海邦要求英國出兵，倫敦卻仍想用錢與談判解決；總督麥卡錫提出過多種方案，包括由英方出錢回贖金凳歸還芬特，並代付戰俘賠償以換取阿散蒂放棄宗主權，阿散蒂一概不接受，而沿海邦與英方之間又無法就戰俘與貢賦達成一致。一八二四年一月，談判破裂，阿散蒂大軍越境攻入芬特諸邦，開普海岸的圍城與費亞塞一役隨即爆發，把一場原本圍繞貢賦與聖物的爭端，變成英國與一個內陸王國之間的正面戰爭。
causeEn: The cause was a knot of grievances, and the most visible of them was the Golden Stool. In 1820 the Asante court carried the stool that embodied the royal soul out of the coastal country and into Kumasi; the Fante states of the coast had always regarded themselves as the stool's guardians, and the removal broke an old understanding. From then on the Asante demanded that the stool be sent back to the coast while the coastal states demanded that the court give it up, and the knot tightened. The second layer was the tribute: the Asante Empire had imposed its suzerainty on the coastal states, taking gold, ivory, captives and goods each year, and that income was what paid for the palace armies and their muskets. Under British protection the coastal states began slipping out of that relationship, and each side expected the other to give way first. The third layer was the failure of British diplomacy. In 1823 the British resident William Bisset was killed on the road to Kumasi, the coastal states demanded troops, but London still wanted the matter settled with money and talks. Governor MacCarthy put forward scheme after scheme, among them buying the Golden Stool back from the Asante to return it to the Fante, and paying the captives' claims on Britain's behalf in exchange for a renunciation of the suzerainty; the Asante refused them all, and Britain and the coastal states could not agree among themselves on the captives and the tribute either. In January 1824 the talks broke down, the Asante army crossed the border into the Fante states, and the siege of Cape Coast and the battle of Feyiase followed, turning what had been a dispute over tribute and a sacred stool into a war in earnest between Britain and an inland kingdom.
impact: 這場仗的後果，超出黃金海岸本身。最實際的一項，是英國在一八二七年把沿岸正式收編為王室殖民地，設總督與議會，把各邦的自衛事務收歸英方；沿海諸邦則得到英國供給的槍械、彈藥與軍事教官，芬特聯邦重新編制出自有軍隊，之後的一八六三至一八六四年戰事英軍沒有正面介入，實際是芬特人自己打的，這支由英軍訓練出來的軍隊從此成為阿散蒂在海岸線上的主要對手。另一項長遠影響在人員：一八二六年英方以獲釋的非洲人組成皇家非洲團，把阿散蒂俘虜中於戰後獲釋的戰士編入英軍建制，這是英國陸軍裡第一支成建制的非洲人部隊，後來隨英國的旗子在埃及、印度與南非作戰。對阿散蒂帝國而言，輸掉的是南線的宗主權：王廷退回內陸，與海岸的貿易改走其他商路；金凳的問題並沒有解決，一八七三至一八七四與一八九三至一八九四年兩役都以此為由重啟戰端，一九〇〇年更直接演成金凳戰爭。對歐洲而言，此役證明一件事：靠海岸據點、有限正規軍與本地聯軍，就足以干涉內陸王國的政治，此後法國、丹麥、荷蘭與德國在非洲的冒險，很多都沿用同一套辦法。英國在這次戰鬥裡也學到自己的短板：砲兵在林地難以展開，彈藥依賴海運，遠征在雨季寸步難行，這些教訓在往後每次阿散蒂遠征中被一次又一次地重新印證。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached well beyond the Gold Coast. The most practical was that in 1827 Britain formally turned the coast into a Crown colony, with a governor and a council, and took the defence of the coastal states into its own hands; the coastal states in turn were given British arms, ammunition and instructors, and the Fante Confederacy rebuilt itself as a military force, so that in the war of 1863 to 1864, when British troops took no part in the fighting, it was the Fante who fought the Asante, with the army Britain had trained serving as the Asante's chief rival on the coast. The other long-term effect lay in personnel: in 1826 Britain raised the Royal African Regiment from liberated Africans, taking Asante captives freed after the war into the ranks of the British establishment, the first formation of African soldiers in the British army, which later marched under the Union flag in Egypt, in India and in South Africa. For the Asante Empire the loss was the suzerainty of the southern line: the court withdrew into the interior and turned its trade to other routes. The question of the stool was not settled; the wars of 1873 to 1874 and of 1893 to 1894 were both fought over it, and in 1900 it came to a head in the War of the Golden Stool. For Europe the lesson of the campaign was that coastal stations, a handful of regulars and native allies were enough to interfere in the politics of an inland kingdom, and the French, Danish, Dutch and German ventures in Africa afterwards repeated the method. Britain also learned its own weaknesses here: field guns could not be got through the forest, ammunition hung on the sea, and an expedition could hardly move in the rains, and each of those lessons was to be relearned in every later Asante expedition.
result: 費亞塞一役，英芬聯軍以線列齊射與刺刀近戰解開了開普海岸的圍城，阿散蒂大軍當場潰散，向內陸退走，圍城解除了。但勝負並沒有像後人說的那樣以攻入庫馬西收場：一八二四年的英軍遠征只推進到海岸內側數十公里，從未進入阿散蒂的都城，庫馬西在這一役中安然無恙；英方能做的是封鎖海岸、派小股隊伍追擊，以及靠封鎖線上的砲火與海軍施壓，切斷阿散蒂進口的槍械與火藥。戰事拖到一八二五年，阿散蒂開始求和；翌年至一八二六年間，雙方以條款了結：阿散蒂放棄對沿海諸邦的宗主權、承認芬特等邦不受其節制，支付戰爭賠款並分期償付，歸還戰利品，英方則在阿散蒂境內設立常駐駐節官，並就金凳一事付出一筆補償，換取沿海邦放棄追索。表面看來這是一場英方全勝的戰爭：英軍在費亞塞得手、圍城解圍，卻沒有佔領阿散蒂的一寸內陸，王位與王廷原封不動。結果是雙方都保留了退路：英國用海岸換內陸的安靜，阿散蒂用內陸換海岸的安寧，而這份脆弱的平衡維持了大約半世紀，直到下一次戰爭再把它打碎。
resultEn: At Feyiase the British and Fante allies broke the siege of Cape Coast with linear volleys and the bayonet, and the Asante army broke up and withdrew inland. But the war did not end, as later accounts like to say, with the British entering Kumasi. The expedition of 1824 pushed only a few tens of kilometres inland from the coast and never reached the Asante capital; Kumasi came through the campaign untouched. What the British could do was blockade the coast, send out small columns in pursuit, and use the guns of the blockade and the Navy's pressure to cut off the Asante's imported muskets and powder. The war dragged on into 1825 and the Asante began to sue for peace; in the year after and in 1826 the two sides settled the matter in terms: the Asante gave up the suzerainty over the coastal states, acknowledged that the Fante and the others were not subject to Kumasi, paid a war indemnity by instalments and returned the spoils, while Britain established a permanent resident in Asante territory and paid the court a compensation over the Golden Stool in exchange for the coastal states dropping their claim to it. On the surface it was a complete British victory: the army won at Feyiase and the siege was lifted, yet not an inch of the Asante interior was occupied and the throne and court were left exactly as they were. The result was that both sides kept a way out: Britain bought quiet in the interior with the coast, the Asante bought quiet on the coast with the interior, and that fragile balance held for about half a century, until the next war broke it.
